posts.meta_description:
poojadhingra on April 20, 2023: "I still can’t believe this happened! 

One of the most defining moments for me as an entrepreneur was when Tim Cook walked into our kitchen, tasted our macarons and other treats, and we spoke about my journey. 

I asked him about leadership, motivating a team and also about my struggles and challenges while trying to scale my business. 

He left us with some wonderful advice that we often seem to forget in our daily lives ~ “always remember that joy is in the journey...” ♥️

I feel extremely grateful to have had this experience and it’s something I’ll cherish all my life 💖".
